Are you looking to grow in a dynamic and international environment in Brussels? We are currently looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support senior management within an organization active in the financial services sector. You will play a key role by providing both strategic and administrative support, ensuring smooth coordination and anticipating needs in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Complex calendar management and coordination of management meetings 
 
• Organization of internal and external meetings (logistics, preparation of materials, follow-up) 
 
• Scheduling meetings with internal and external stakeholders 
 
• Inbox management (screening, prioritizing, drafting responses when needed) 
 
• Preparation of meetings (agendas, documents, minutes, and follow-up on action points) 
 
• Organization of domestic and international business travel (bookings, itineraries, logistics) 
 
• Support with expense management 
 
• Acting as a point of contact for internal and external stakeholders 
 
• Welcoming visitors and organizing on-site meetings 
 
• Coordination of catering and meeting logistics 
 
• Providing ad hoc support on projects and operational follow-ups 
 
• Handling confidential information with a high level of discretion 

 
 
• Minimum 7 years of experience as an Executive Assistant 
 
• Excellent command of English (C1 level minimum), French is a plus 
 
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite 
 
• High level of discretion and confidentiality 
 
• Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization skills 
 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 
• Proactive, autonomous, and solution-oriented mindset 
 
• Ability to multitask and work under pressure 
 
• Strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills 
 
• Experience in an international or multicultural environment 
 
• Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset

As a Printing Assistant, you will provide essential administrative support to the Controlling department.

Client Details

Life Sciences

Description

As a Printing Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Archive, classify, and convert paper files into digital records
• Perform quality checks on documents

• Bilingual French and English

As a Bus Diagnostic Technician, you’ll help lead the transition to smart, electric passenger transport. You’ll work in a modern workshop where you track down, analyze, and solve technical faults on buses from various brands. From day one, you play a crucial role in getting our vehicles back on the road quickly and safely.

On a typical workday, you analyze malfunctions using diagnostic equipment, read error codes, and interpret electrical diagrams. You carry out mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs and maintain precise work administration. You support colleagues with complex problems, assist with roadside service during working hours, and continue to learn about new technologies such as electric drive systems.

Are you ready to further develop your technical expertise in a rapidly evolving sector? Apply today and discover a varied job where quality, teamwork, and innovation are key!

• Degree in automotive engineering, electromechanics, or equivalent through experience

• At least 2 years of experience as a diagnostic, bus, or truck technician

• Strong knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and electronics

• Experience with diagnostic equipment

• Valid driver's license B (D is a plus)

• Good command of Dutch or English

• Accurate, quality-oriented, and a real team player

• Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is a plus, but not required

• Technical mindset and eagerness to learn are essential

• Willingness for occasional roadside service during or outside working hours

• Service vehicle for business and private use (after 6 months)

Are you technically inclined and eager to work in a dynamic production environment where you can continuously develop yourself? Then this position as an assembly worker in a 2-shift system might be something for you!

About Us: 
 

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities:
 

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Production Technician to join our microbial production team. In this role, you will play a key part in producing beneficial microorganisms used in biostimulant, biocontrol, and biofertilizer products that support healthy crop growth. Training will be provided, so prior microbiology experience is not required — though it's a plus. Curiosity and attention to detail matter most.
 

 
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• You independently carry out production tasks according to standard procedures: you prepare supplies, sterilize, inoculate, harvest and handle downstream processing. 

• You work under sterile conditions and strictly follow hygiene and sterility protocols, giving contamination no chance. 

• You safeguard product quality at every stage by performing in-process quality and sterility checks. 

• You help with downstream processing and carry out quantification checks as part of the final quality control. 

• You actively contribute to continuous improvement (TPM) and help find solutions when problems arise. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You have a technical or scientific background: a secondary school diploma, an associate degree (graduaat) or equivalent practical experience. 

• You enjoy steady, hands-on work and feel right at home in it. 

• You understand the basics of microbiology: you know what bacteria and fungi are and how contamination occurs, and you're interested in sterility and hygiene. 

• Repetitive tasks don't put you off: you stay focused and precise, even over long periods. 

• You can stand for extended periods and regularly lift and carry moderate loads without difficulty. 

• Have you worked with an ELN (Electronic Lab Notebook) before? That's a plus, but we'll train you either way. 

• You're responsible, reliable and a true team player, and safety and hygiene in the workplace come naturally to you. 

• You speak and write both Dutch and English fluently.

Our client is an established international banking institution operating in Luxembourg, a key European financial hub. The organisation combines a strong regulatory and risk management culture with an ambitious technology and digital transformation agenda. They are looking for a Head of IT based in Luxembourg. 

The organisation fosters collaboration between Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Internal Audit, and Business teams, creating an environment where technology is viewed as a strategic enabler of growth, resilience, and operational excellence. The successful candidate will join a leadership team committed to strengthening governance, enhancing resilience frameworks, and supporting the bank's long-term transformation objectives.

As Head of IT, you will be responsible for defining and strengthening the local technology governance framework while ensuring alignment with business strategy, risk appetite, and Group Technology standards.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading the local technology governance agenda and establishing effective governance committees, KPIs, KRIs, and reporting structures.
• Acting as the primary point of contact for technology-related matters involving the CSSF and coordinating regulatory responses, inspections, reviews, and remediation activities.
• Owning the local ICT risk management framework, including risk identification, assessment, reporting, mitigation planning, and ongoing monitoring.
• Providing clear and actionable technology risk reporting to senior management and governance bodies.
• Driving the implementation and continuous enhancement of DORA requirements and digital operational resilience capabilities.
• Overseeing ICT incident management processes, resilience testing, business continuity planning, and disaster recovery exercises.
• Managing third-party technology risks, including outsourced services, cloud environments, contractual obligations, information registers, and exit strategies.
• Monitoring technology service delivery, performance, capacity, control effectiveness, vulnerabilities, and resilience metrics.
• Coordinating internal and external audits while ensuring timely implementation of corrective actions.
• Collaborating closely with Business, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Group Technology stakeholders.
• Leading and developing the local technology team while promoting a strong governance, risk, and control culture.
• Supporting strategic technology initiatives, transformation programmes, and regulatory projects across the organisation.

The ideal candidate is an experienced technology leader with a strong background in technology governance, ICT risk management, and regulatory compliance within the financial services sector.

Key requirements include:

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in technology leadership, governance, risk, or control-related functions.
• Proven experience within banking, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
• Strong understanding of the Luxembourg regulatory landscape, particularly CSSF technology-related requirements.
• Demonstrated exposure to regulatory reviews, audits, supervisory inspections, and remediation programmes.
• Experience overseeing outsourced ICT services, cloud environments, and third-party technology providers.
• Strong knowledge of ICT risk management frameworks, operational resilience, cybersecurity governance, and DORA requirements.
• Ability to communicate complex technology and risk concepts to executive stakeholders in a concise and business-oriented manner.
• Experience working within matrix organisations and managing relationships across multiple stakeholder groups.
• University degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related discipline.
• Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISA, CGEIT, CISSP, ITIL, or ISO 27001 are considered a strong advantage.
• Fluent English & Spanish are mandatory, while French would be considered an asset.

Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

Responsibilities

• Define and promote front-end development standards, architecture guidelines, and reusable frameworks across the organization.
• Provide technical leadership and architectural governance to multiple delivery teams to ensure solution consistency.
• Manage the technology lifecycle and drive initiatives to reduce technical debt and upgrade core platforms.
• Translate complex business and functional requirements into sustainable technical architectures and documentation.
• Lead the adoption of emerging technologies, specifically focusing on Artificial Intelligence and innovation within development practices.
• Conduct technology evaluations, impact assessments, and performance optimization for enterprise-grade web applications.
• Coach and mentor developers to enhance the team’s technical skills and foster a community of practice.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience as a Technical Architect or Solution Architect within a complex enterprise environment.
• 3+ years of expert-level knowledge in Angular and modern front-end development practices.
• 3+ years of experience with .NET and .NET Core ecosystems.
• 3+ years of experience in Web Security standards and secure development practices.
• 3+ years of experience with Authentication and Authorization standards including OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
• You possess a strong background in designing enterprise-grade web applications with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability.
• You bring the ability to produce high-quality architecture documentation and technical implementation guidelines.
• You're an experienced technical leader with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset and strong analytical capabilities.
• You have excellent communication skills and the ability to present technical decisions to governance boards.
• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French, with at least basic knowledge of the other.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot or GenAI solutions.
• Knowledge of Design Systems and UI component libraries.
• Previous experience in the insurance or financial services sector.
• Experience working within an Architecture Board or similar corporate governance body.
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager CAPEX Process Industry
jobs.description:
Project overview

As CAPEX Project Manager, you drive large multidisciplinary investment projects within the process industry. You take full responsibility for scope, budget, schedule, quality and safety, covering both greenfield developments and substantial revamps or modifications of existing industrial facilities.

Primary tasks & responsibilities

• Lead industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept definition through engineering, execution, commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Steer all project phases, including pre-studies, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, on-site activities, commissioning and operational transfer.
• Act as the central point of accountability for stakeholders and management across the entire project lifecycle.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS disciplines, working with both internal and external parties.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims and deviations affecting budget, planning or delivery.
• Report in a structured way on progress, issues and key decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also have at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in fields such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You bring solid expertise in pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Background in the process industry is essential.
• You have strong hands-on knowledge of MS Project and personally own project planning rather than only tracking it.
• You combine an academic mindset with strong analytical skills and a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and take full ownership of your responsibilities.
• You show strong leadership and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when required.
• You communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders at every level of the organisation.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

Responsibilities

• Design and drive a comprehensive change plan using structured methodologies such as ADKAR.
• Create conditions for successful adoption by anticipating resistance and supporting impacted teams during the transition.
• Plan and coordinate change activities to ensure internal and external stakeholders are prepared for new ways of working.
• Collaborate with core project teams to align communication strategies and project priorities.
• Monitor progress and identify potential risks to provide clear status reporting.
• Facilitate workshops and co-creation sessions linked to process improvement and transformation.

Requirements

• You have proven experience in change management for large-scale digital transformations.
• You possess deep knowledge of the ADKAR methodology and its practical application.
• You're experienced in stakeholder management and engaging with diverse teams at all organizational levels.
• You bring a structured and proactive approach to planning and following up on change activities.
• You have strong skills in facilitating workshops and brainstorming sessions.
• You are fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Previous experience within the telecommunications industry.
• Willingness to visit local sites to collect feedback and build trust with teams.

Are you the Incident Manager we’re looking for?

We are looking for an experienced Incident / Problem Manager to join an Application Support team based in Brussels.

You will play a key role in managing application-related incidents and problems, with a strong focus on reducing recurring incidents, improving service stability, and driving continuous improvement.

You will join a small, collaborative team and work closely with technical and application support teams to ensure incidents are effectively managed, root causes are identified, and appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
Role
• Manage the end-to-end Incident Management process for application-related incidents.
• Lead and coordinate the Problem Management process, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
• Monitor and follow up on application-related incidents, ensuring appropriate prioritisation and resolution.
• Identify trends and recurring incidents and implement actions to reduce incident volumes.
• Support the management of incidents across different priority levels, including P3–P4.
• Monitor application environments using Datadog.
• Work with ServiceNow for incident and problem management.
• Analyse incident trends and identify opportunities for service improvement.
• Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and technical teams to resolve complex issues.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of application support and IT service management processes.
• Participate in an on-call rotation, currently expected to be approximately one week in three. Out-of-hours incident volumes are currently low.
Profile
We are looking for someone with a backgound Incident Management, Problem Management, or Application Support experience.

You should have:

• Proven experience in Incident Management and/or Problem Management or Support engineering. .
• Previous experience within an Application Support environment.
• Experience working with ServiceNow.
• Experience with Datadog or a similar monitoring solution.
• Good working knowledge of SQL.
• A hands-on approach and the ability to work closely with technical teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
• The ability to work effectively in a small, collaborative team.
• Fluent/professional English.
